comment_text.value:
AiMi | Full Stack AI Engineer | Remote(Everywhere) | Full-time

AiMi builds agentic AI infrastructure for capital markets: autonomous agents that ingest venue and vendor notifications, assess impact across client infrastructure, and drive change management workflows in real time, replacing what used to be manual, static processes for exchanges and their ops teams. live production platform, not a pilot.

you'd work across the full stack: React/TypeScript frontend, Node.js backend, AWS Lambda. concretely: shipping features in the agent pipeline, building MCP-based connectors and skills that extend what our agents can reach, running evals on agent accuracy and reliability, building observability and alerting for agent latency/error rates/failed workflows, and making long-running LLM, agent, and SSE calls actually resilient (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, fail-fast, recovery). also a fair amount of diagnosing dependency/version conflicts in a Node.js/npm monorepo, which is its own skill.

looking for 2-3+ years hands-on experience, solid Node.js and REST API background, real hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks (Mastra, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Claude, OpenAI or similar), comfortable with AWS (Lambda, Bedrock, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito, API Gateway, CloudWatch), MongoDB/DynamoDB, and genuinely tests what you ship (unit, integration, e2e). familiarity with spec-driven development (Claude Code, Cursor, CodeRabbit or similar) is a real plus since that's how we work day to day. bonus points for capital markets/trading infra background, LLM observability tooling like Langfuse, SSE streaming experience, or PostHog.

you'd be working on great things here: real architectural decisions at an early-stage company, visible impact from week one, and room to grow into a senior or lead role as we grow.

apply: https://join.com/companies/aimitechnology/16658631-agentic-a... , or reach out directly at vishnu.swaroop@aimi.technology

comment_text.value:
Mastra | Customer Engineer | REMOTE (AMER or EMEA time zones) | Full-time

Mastra is the open-source TypeScript framework for building AI agents (agents, workflows, memory, evals, tracing). From the team behind Gatsby, YC-backed,https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra

We're hiring a customer engineer. Some companies would call this an FDE; we don't, because roughly half the job is shipping in the framework itself. The other half you're embedded with paying customers deploying agents to production: in their Slack channels and on calls, writing code in their repos, reviewing their PRs, working through architecture with their engineers. What you learn there comes back as bug fixes, features, and new primitives in Mastra. One of our current customer engineers is among the top bug-fixers in the entire codebase.

You should be a full-stack TypeScript engineer who has built agents and who can explain technical decisions clearly to engineers who haven't seen your code.

Remote. We have a lot of EU customers and response-time SLAs, so US Eastern/Central or EU hours work best.

Process: a call with Shane (co-founder/CPO, leads customer engineering), a conversation with a customer engineer, a 2-3 hour take-home, then you present it to us and get feedback.

Apply: {https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Mastra/05172cb0-47ec-44f9-9fe8-07d4...} We get back to everyone.

Republic Services | Staff Engineer – Agentic AI | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | $175k is our salary midpoint + 20% target bonus

Republic Services is the second largest environmental services companies in North America — ~40K employees, thousands of trucks, hundreds of facilities, and a mountain of operational data that has never had an AI layer on top of it. We have a backlog of hundreds of Agentic AI ideas that we need to deliver and a foundation of ontologies, evaluations, guardrails, etc... that we need to build.

We're hiring a Staff Engineer now to be the first hire and plan to expand the team aggressively. You will own that platform end to end, not manage the people.

What you'll work on

- Agent orchestration: tool calling, planner/executor and multi-agent patterns, MCP/A2A integrations with enterprise systems

- Making enterprise context reliably available at inference time — retrieval, memory, hybrid search, reranking, access controls

- LLMOps that isn't hand-wavy: evals and golden datasets, prompt/agent versioning, tracing, token and cost budgets, CI/CD for agents

- Safety in a regulated enterprise: prompt injection, data exfiltration, PII handling, human-in-the-loop, audit logging

You should have

- 7–10+ years building and scaling production systems, with recent, hands-on GenAI/agentic work in production (not just demos)

- Shipped agents or LLM pipelines at scale

- Solid data chops — vector stores, chunking, hybrid search, knowing when retrieval is the wrong answer

- Cloud experience (we're primarily AWS / Bedrock); comfortable with both containers and serverless

- Track record of technical leadership and mentoring without needing a manager title

Nice to have: LangGraph / Semantic Kernel / PydanticAI, GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, LangFuse/LangSmith, multimodal.

Comp & benefits: $175k is our midpoint for salary + 20% annual target bonus, 401(k) with company match, ESPP, medical/dental/vision, PTO. Remote eligible, prefer AZ timezones +/-1. Not sponsorship eligible.

Why you should want to work here: We build cool stuff

email me (jgardner@republicservices.com) directly with the most interesting agent you've shipped.

Interview Resources | 2 Full Stack AI Engineer, 1 GTM | REMOTE | Full-Time | $250k seed raised

Interview Resources is building an AI-powered deep research platform for interview preparation. Instead of generic interview guides, we autonomously research company-specific interview experiences across Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn, engineering blogs, company websites, Glassdoor, and other public sources, then generate structured preparation reports in minutes.

We are already profitable with 3k+ paid users.

Our stack currently includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Vercel, AWS, and modern AI tooling. Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, MCP, RAG, vector databases, or AI agents is a strong plus, but curiosity and the ability to learn quickly matter more.

We're looking for someone who:

Has strong full-stack engineering skills. Has built and deployed production applications. Loves working with AI and LLM-powered products. Takes ownership and ships quickly. Has personal projects or open-source work they're proud of.

Expected salary: $30k – $90k (flexible based on experience, impact, and per capita)

Expected Joining Date: 1st October

To apply, visit https://www.interviewresources.app/careers (No Email; my email is spammed) with:

1. Your CV/Resume. Your GitHub profile.

2. Why do you like InterviewResources? (product-driven answer) Log in to the site and just see some sample reports.

3. One piece of work or project you're most proud of (include links if possible).

4. Please include your expected salary and location in your application.

Human-written messages are more likely to get a response.

Try: https://www.interviewresources.app

Mondrio | Founding Product Engineer | San Francisco | ONSITE | $200k – $250k plus equity

Mondrio (https://mondrio.io) builds agentic pricing management: AI agents plus pricing experts that keep B2B pricing current rather than a one-off, one-time exercise. The founding team ran 150+ pricing engagements before starting the company and are translating that expertise to shape the next frontier of pricing in the agentic era.

The role comes with significant scope and high autonomy. You will own the full product lifecycle: customer discovery -> rapid prototyping -> agent-ready specs -> shipping via agentic orchestration -> o11y and evals -> growth & expansion.

Here are some domains you will ship: - Multi-agent simulation to emulate the behavior of a buying committee - A2A pricing interactions governed by OPA/Rego policies defined from natural language - Generative UX driven by a MCP server with full system capabilities access - Autonomous quote generation and real-time deal intelligence during sales calls

We don't have PMs or product designers so you serve as the product bridge between the founders, pricing experts, and engineering. If you're a mature engineer, looking to work with a very senior/staff team across the stack: customers, models, server, clients (web, TUI, chatbots), evals, then this is the role for you. In short, the role is ideal for someone who has significant product engineering expertise and has sharpened their SDLC competency to be AI-native.

Apply at https://ats.rippling.com/mondrio/jobs/9fefe011-331a-43a2-83a....

comment_text.value:
Source (https://source.inc)| USA/Canada: REMOTE | Full-Time

Our mission: make handling memory, state, and context for AI agents outside the cloud as simple as it is in the cloud. Today it isn't close. An agent without data is inert, and outside the cloud, data is duct tape.

An agent in the field needs data that is verifiable, auditable, concurrent, collaborative, and permissioned. No single system gives you all five. SQLite gives you local storage and nothing else. Every other database assumes the cloud is there to provide the rest.

We're building the data layer agents actually run on: local-first, syncs peer to peer, every write verifiable, every read auditable, no cloud required. The stack is open source: https://github.com/sourcenetwork/defradb. We think it's the best memory an agent can have, bar none.

We’re growing fast and are looking to fill the following positions:

-Chief of Staff - https://source.network/careers/chief-of-staff

-Growth Hacker, Developer Adoption - https://source.network/careers/growth-hacker-developer-adopt...

-Head of Business Development - https://source.network/careers/head-of-business-development

Zepto | Senior Security Engineer (product security) | REMOTE (AUS) | https://zepto.bamboohr.com/careers/104

As a Senior Security Engineer (Product Security), you will play a significant role in keeping our product safe and secure by building on and maturing Zepto's product security practices. You will work hands-on and shoulder-to-shoulder with Engineering and Product teams, providing guidance and coaching across the software development life cycle while continuing to raise the bar on our security expectations and capability.

This is a security role at its core, but not a gatekeeping one. We are builders – we expect you to read and write production-level code, build tooling and automation, and contribute paved-road solutions that engineers actually want to use. Reporting to the Security Engineering Lead, you will work closely with them to develop and build Zepto's product security strategy and approach. You will apply a consultative and advisory approach when working with the wider Zepto team, empowering them to work confidently and to use the self-service capabilities you help establish.

We have excellent working relationships with our developers and we need to keep it that way. We are not the team of no. We are the team that helps make things better.

Zepto is moving quickly towards an AI-native way of building and operating. You will be someone who is already experimenting with AI and agentic tooling, or is genuinely keen to, and who is open to developing the skills to secure these systems as we adopt them. Within the Security team, you are the go-to person for:

Secure development practices Vulnerability management Security architecture advice

Working in a scale-up, means you get the opportunity to flex your skills in a variety of ways. We are agile and always willing to roll up our sleeves to get things done. You can, however, expect your day to day to be involved in the following:

Coach engineering teams and collaborate to ensure every step of the software development life cycle follows security best practices Design, build and maintain security tooling, automation and paved-road controls as production-quality software Conduct security assessments and architecture reviews of Zepto's applications and services Embed within project teams to ensure they are effectively considering information security risk and prioritising security controls Establish and document security architecture and practices in collaboration with the Security Engineering Lead, Product and Engineering teams Work with the Security Engineering Lead to support Zepto's adoption of AI and agentic systems, and experiment with AI tooling to improve how the Security team works Help manage application security incidents in collaboration with the rest of the Security team

Balerion AI | Software + FDE + AI Engineers | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE | Full-time | $250k+ base + seed equity | Visa sponsorship available | https://balerion.ai

We're building agentic AI for mortgage lending — automating document processing and income qualification for loan originators.

Underwriting a loan means pulling numbers out of a few hundred pages of paystubs, W-2s, bank statements, and tax returns, then applying underwriting guidelines that run to thousands of pages of edge cases. Most of it is still done by hand.

Problems we actually work on: routing scanned pages to OCR vs. text extraction when the text layer is unreliable; extraction pipelines where a wrong number is much worse than a missing one; running long agent workflows durably so a failure three steps in doesn't restart the whole loan; and evaluating multi-step output against guidelines that are themselves ambiguous. We put real effort into eval infrastructure, because "the demo looked good" does not survive contact with a lender's compliance team.

Stack: Python, PydanticAI, Restate for durable execution, Postgres, AWS. Frontier models from OpenAI and Anthropic plus open-source models where they win on cost or latency.

We raised an $8M seed led by Kleiner Perkins and have paying customers in production. Team previously at Snowflake, PayPal, Twitter, Atlassian, and Microsoft.

Comp: $250k+ base, meaningful seed-stage equity, 5% 401(k) match, full health coverage, commuter stipend, gym membership, daily office breakfast & lunch. Full relocation to SF covered.

Onsite in SF. Visa sponsorship: yes.

Email hiring@balerion.ai with "HN" in the subject, plus a resume or GitHub.

Shepherd (Series B) | ONSITE | San Francisco, CA

At Shepherd, we're pursuing the most ambitious technical vision in commercial insurance: fully autonomous underwriting. Shepherd is an AI-native commercial insurance platform transforming how high-hazard industries get covered.

The infrastructure behind the AI boom (data centers, semiconductor fabs, renewable energy assets) has to be built and insured, but traditional carriers weren't built for this speed. We built Shepherd to solve that.

We announced our $42M Series B earlier this year! That brings our total funding to over $60M — led by Intact Private Capital, the investment arm of one of the largest insurers in the world. Intact is not only our lead investor but also a carrier partner, a testament to the confidence the incumbent industry has in what we're building.

We’re looking for product-minded, high ownership engineers to join our team! The Engineering team is HQ’d in SF, but we’re growing in NYC now too!

We’re hiring for 4 Senior SWEs, 1 MLE and 1 AI PM in SF, and 2 Staff SWEs in NYC. Engineers own projects end-to-end so full stack ability is expected.

Check out our open roles here: https://shepherdinsurance.com/careers

Our stack includes: Typescript, React, Next.js, GraphQL w/ Apollo, Node.js, Postgres & Redis

– If you have experience building AI agents or multi-step reasoning systems, we’d love to hear from you.

* In the form, be sure to mention that you heard about this opportunity via Hacker News.

If you want to read more about our team and culture, check out our blog: https://shepherdinsurance.com/blog

Hiring: 2 Engineers + Director of Sales & Operations

Energy is becoming one of the biggest constraints on AI infrastructure. Neuralwatt is building software to help datacenters get more useful AI compute and revenue from every kilowatt.

We're a VC-backed early-stage startup working on GPU optimization, AI infrastructure, energy-aware control systems, and the Neuralwatt Cloud.

$180k to $220k DOE + equity

You'll work on: Rust and Python, GPU, inference, and datacenter optimization, Production AI infrastructure, Energy-aware scheduling and control, Neuralwatt Cloud

Director of Sales & Operations

We're looking for someone with datacenter industry experience to build sales channels, partnerships, and customer relationships, support company operations, and help drive growth. Comfort using modern AI and agent tools is required.

Location: Remote-first, but you must be based in the Seattle or Denver/Boulder metro areas.

No visa sponsorship available.

To apply: hiring@neuralwatt.com Subject: HN Hiring (<your metro>/<engineering or sales>)

Include your resume, GitHub or relevant work profile, and a short note on why you're interested in AI and energy.

OpenAlex | Software Engineer | Remote | Full-time | $150–200k USD

OpenAlex is an open index of the world's scholarly research: hundreds of millions of articles linked to authors, institutions, and topics, free via API and bulk download. Traffic runs about a billion API calls per month from universities, governments, and AI companies. The team behind it is a small nonprofit funded by grants and enterprise support.

We're hiring two engineers to work across the whole backend, which is SQL and PySpark on Databricks, Python/Flask APIs, Elasticsearch, and Cloudflare Workers. It's a small team with lots of autonomy. You'll notice what's missing, build it, ship it, and answer the tickets about it. We're AI-native, with agents writing all of our code.

Apply here: https://openalex.org/jobs/software-engineer
